toegepas.voor: het graan geplant en vee gehad en tog steeds wild gejag
toegepas.na: het graan geplant en vee aangehou, maar hulle het steeds wild gejag
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two chained 'en' clauses read heavily; 'vee aanhou' is the idiomatic verb, and 'maar' carries the contrast of 'tog' with the AWS comma before a full clause.
toegepas.fout: Two chained 'en' clauses with 'tog' read heavily, and 'vee gehad' is flat where 'vee aanhou' is the idiomatic verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Clearer contrast with the idiomatic verb; same people, actions and meaning, and 'jag' stays.

toegepas.voor: kon hy of sy na tradisionele genesers toe gaan vir hulp
toegepas.na: kon hy of sy vir hulp na tradisionele genesers toe gaan
toegepas.rede_vinder: The purpose phrase belongs before the verb group; 'gaan vir hulp' at the end follows English order.
toegepas.fout: 'toe gaan vir hulp' trails the purpose phrase after the verb group in English order.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Standard Afrikaans order with no change in meaning; the protected 'tradisionele genesers' is untouched.

toegepas.voor: sê mense vandag vir die een soort geneser 'n sangoma en vir die ander 'n inyanga
toegepas.na: noem mense vandag die een soort geneser 'n sangoma en die ander soort 'n inyanga
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'sê vir ... 'n' is colloquial; 'noem' is the standard written form, and 'die ander soort' keeps the parallel clear.
toegepas.fout: 'sê vir ... 'n sangoma' is colloquial and the second half of the parallel is loose.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'noem' is the plain written form and 'die ander soort' only makes the parallel explicit; both names stay as they are.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The second 'het' is redundant when both verbs share the same auxiliary.
toegepas.fout: The repeated auxiliary 'het' makes the clause heavy.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Dropping the shared auxiliary is a clean grammatical tidy with the meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Genesers het oor honderde jare op dié manier siek mense bly help.
toegepas.na: Op dié manier het genesers honderde jare lank siek mense bly help.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'oor honderde jare' copies 'over hundreds of years'; Afrikaans says 'honderde jare lank', and fronting 'Op dié manier' links better to the previous sentence.
toegepas.fout: 'oor honderde jare' copies English 'over hundreds of years'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'honderde jare lank' is the natural Afrikaans form and the fronted link reads well; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Jy kry' for 'there are' is colloquial; 'Daar is' is the neutral written form.
toegepas.fout: 'Jy kry' for 'there are' is an anglicism from 'you get'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Daar is' is plain, natural written Afrikaans and says the same thing.

laat_vaar.voor: bokke en hase gejag vir die vleis
laat_vaar.na: bokke en hase vir die vleis gejag
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Afrikaans puts the past participle after the adverbial phrase; the extraposed 'gejag vir die vleis' follows English order.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Extraposing the paired 'vir die vleis en ook vir die velle' phrase is natural; the proposal splits that parallel and reads worse.

laat_vaar.voor: Net soos ons het die boere ook soms
laat_vaar.na: Net soos ons het die boere soms
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'ook' repeats what 'net soos ons' already says.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Net soos ons ... ook' is a normal Afrikaans pattern; dropping 'ook' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: Maar party genesers het albei soorte werk gedoen.
laat_vaar.na: Party genesers het egter albei soorte werk gedoen.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A sentence opening with 'Maar' is spoken style; 'egter' gives the same contrast in written text and keeps 'party'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Opening with 'Maar' is acceptable and plain for Grade 5; 'egter' is more formal without being clearly better.

vlae.teks: Hulle het ook ander middels uit die natuur gebruik.
vlae.rede: Vague: 'ander middels' does not say what kind of remedies; making it concrete would need content, so it is flagged rather than changed.

vlae.teks: 'n Sangoma het geestelike leiding gegee. Hy of sy het die voorouers om leiding gevra.
vlae.rede: 'leiding' appears in two consecutive sentences with different givers; avoiding it would shift the meaning or the glossary-matched wording, so it is left for the reviewer or writer.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry is 'nyanga', but the lesson and its glossary headword use 'inyanga' throughout, so the protection never matches the text. A person should decide which form is meant and align the entry (the word was not changed).

The entry protects 'geslag' in the sense of gender, but here it appears only in 'van geslag tot geslag' (generation), which is correct; no change proposed, noted so the entry's reason is not read as applying here.
